title: Your turn: switch on the right connector
learner: Same bakery owner, new question. Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Slack are all connected, and you choose which one Claude uses.

connectors.name: Gmail
connectors.description: Draft replies, summarize threads, and search your inbox

connectors.name: Google Calendar
connectors.description: See your schedule and find open times

steps.text: Thursday looks busy. Ask Claude which customer calls are on it.
Which customer calls do I have on Thursday?
I can't see your schedule yet. Switch on the connector that has it, from + → Connectors.

steps.prompt: Switch on the connector Claude needs for this question. Click it in the menu.

hints.Gmail: Gmail is on. I can see a few emails that mention calls, but not when they actually are. Which connector holds your appointments?
hints.Google Drive: Drive has your files, not your schedule. Try the one that keeps your appointments.
hints.Slack: Slack has your team's messages, not your customer appointments.

steps.fallback: That one won't have your schedule. Try another.

steps.text: Three customer calls on Thursday: 9:30 Jenna Park (cake tasting), 1:00 Café Lune (wholesale order), 4:15 Tom Alvarez (catering quote).
One connector, matched to the question. The rest stayed off because this question didn't need them.

steps.title: Nicely picked
steps.text: Now with your own tools: switch on only what the task needs, then ask.
steps.prompt: Using my calendar, list this week's customer appointments and flag any that overlap with a delivery.
